create.name: Joy Adler
create.bio:
Joy Adler is an energy healer and teacher based near Albany, New York, who opened her private practice in 1993. She trained at the Barbara Brennan School of Healing, the school that grew out of Barbara Brennan's book Hands of Light, and now serves there as a dean, guiding first-year students in New York and the advanced studies programme in Florida. Her wider training takes in pastoral counselling, hypnotherapy, yoga, Ayurvedic nutrition and massage, as well as several years learning shamanic practice from Indigenous elders.

Music sits at the centre of her work. A singer and recording artist, she leads a group of musicians called The Souls of Evolution, uses voice and instruments in her sessions and has released a number of albums made for healing and reflection. Her YouTube channel holds a set of guided meditations for each of the chakras, many with harp or live sound behind them, and she co-hosts a podcast of conversations with healers and musicians. For more than twenty years she has led the introductory Hands of Light weekend, which she now also brings to Kripalu along with a programme drawn from Brennan's second book, Light Emerging.

courses.title: Hands of Light: The Fundamentals of Brennan Healing Science
courses.description: A five-night residential introduction to the energy-healing model set out in Barbara Brennan's Hands of Light, held at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts. Joy covers grounding, energetic boundaries, the layers of the human energy field and hands-on techniques, with time to practise in pairs; beginners and experienced practitioners are both welcome.

courses.title: Light Emerging: A Journey of Personal Healing
courses.description: A weekend at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, built around Barbara Brennan's second book, Light Emerging. Through meditation, sound and guided energy work, participants look at how beliefs and emotions shape the energy field and how to reconnect with a sense of purpose.

flags: Her private sessions page sells the work partly on conditions (pre- and post-operative work, chronic pain, emotional trauma said to lead to disease, narcissistic abuse); sessions are left out as an offering and the bio avoids all of it. A human may want to judge whether her practice as a whole is too condition-led for a listing.
Second photo is her YouTube avatar, a stage shot of her singing; it matches the Kripalu headshot as far as I can tell, but it is not a close headshot.
Kept the Kripalu programme title 'Light Emerging: A Journey of Personal Healing' (the title of Brennan's book); it names no condition.
Queue dates for her programmes were right this time (8-13 Nov 2026 and 7-9 May 2027), confirmed on the programme pages.
The Hands of Light and Light Emerging names come from Barbara Brennan's books, which are not Joy's, so they are not listed as books.
left_out: Private healing sessions ($125 USD, Albany or long distance): the page frames them around surgery, chronic pain, disease and abuse recovery.
Energy Diagnostics course and Relationship Master Class: no page of their own, payment by email; 'diagnostics' wording also too close to the no-'diagnose' rule.
Barbara Brennan School of Healing promotional and graduation videos, music videos and songs: not teaching.
Energy Diagnostics Podcast episodes: co-hosted interviews where guests do most of the talking.
Music albums: not an item type here.
